summary: V6.3 fully GREEN. Backend: 13/13 new V6.3 tests pass + 15/15 V6.2 regression pass (28/28 combined). Frontend: all four V6.3 critical UI fixes verified — (1) EpicCampaignPanel renders without runtime errors on a besm-4e campaign Genesis → EPIC CAMPAIGN tab (Phase 8 of 9 loads, sections 1·THE PLAN, 2·THEME, 3·THE SENTENCE etc all render, ZERO pageerrors collected during full panel mount); (2) CharacterSheet system-label correctly reflects campaign.system_id across all four systems — besm-4e='BESM 4E · Heroic · 200 pts', anime-5e='Anime 5E · Fighter 1 · Human', dnd-5e='D&D 5E · Fighter 1 · Human', cypher='Cypher · Tier 1 · Tough Warrior'; (3) Cypher /new builder shows the discretionary-points chip (testid='cypher-pool-budget-chip', visible text 'DISCRETIONARY 0 / 6' for default Warrior); (4) BESM Enhancement/Limiter/Defect tags carry hover tooltips — sample title attr 'Enhancement: Range. Lowers the Attributes effective Level by 1 — the power is more potent per CP paid. Stacks if listed multiple times.' confirmed on a live BESM character. Backend POST /api/reference/estimate-bundle-cost returns the documented breakdown (attribute 4×3−2=10, skill 2×2=4, defect −2 → total 12). Reference editor accepts new kinds: enhancement, limiter, power_pack, power_bundle, spell, feat, cypher_ability. Unknown kind on GET ?kind=foo returns 400 as expected.

smoke_limitations.issue: No seeded Cypher character had non-zero skill_trains entries in the test environment, so the title-attribute on rendered skill-train tags could not be DOM-asserted. Source review of CharacterSheet.jsx confirms the tags emit a title attr derived from train value (Trained/Specialised/Inability). Builder /new for Cypher renders the SKILL TRAINING grid correctly. Recommend manual smoke after seeding a Cypher PC with skill_trains[].

The Beginning section in the Epic Campaign panel is collapsible — its testid only attaches when the section is expanded. Test verified the panel mounts without pageerrors and renders multiple sections; the kind-select itself is wired in source. Direct testid query returned null while the section was collapsed.

action_items: (Optional) Add data-testid='cypher-type-input' on the Cypher TYPE select in builders/Cypher.jsx — at present the type select has no testid; the chip still renders correctly because Warrior is auto-selected by default.
(Optional, for next testing iter) Seed a Cypher PC with skill_trains[] populated so future Playwright agents can DOM-assert the title attribute on Trained/Specialised/Inability tags.
critical_code_review_comments: reference_editor.py:estimate_bundle_cost — math is clean: attribute uses max(0, gross-refund) so a refund cannot push a single attribute below 0 (good — refunds belong on the attribute, not on the bundle). Defects subtract from total. Enhancement/limiter explicitly score 0 and document that the builder applies the effective-level math, which matches CharacterValidator's CP path. No drift between estimator and validator.

REFERENCE_KINDS expanded from 8 → 23. Both the Pydantic Literal and the runtime allow-list are kept in sync. Worth refactoring to derive the Literal from the set in a future patch (currently duplicated by hand — easy to drift).

EpicCampaignPanel defensive normalisation: confirmed by zero pageerrors during full mount on a real besm-4e Genesis (previous iter reported '.kind' on undefined). Recommend leaving the normalisation in place even after seed templates are upgraded — it acts as a permanent guard.
BundleComponentIn uses cost_per_level: float but level: int — a float cost_per_level avoids integer truncation when authors enter half-cost attributes. Good call.

success_rate.frontend: 4/4 critical flows verified (Epic panel mount, system label, cypher chip, besm tooltips)
